title: Tailwise Autoship Enrollment: Program Placement and Conditions
content:
A Tailwise Autoship subscription is created in status pending first shipment, in the program that the item's class decides. Enrolling is free and carries no minimum term.

## Program placement by item class

| Item class | Program | Entry conditions on the program |
|---|---|---|
| Standard catalog item | Autoship Everyday | — |
| Heavy bulk item, unit weighing at least 35 lb (the Litter & Bulk entry weight) | Autoship Litter & Bulk | unit weight at least 35 lb |
| Refrigerated or frozen item | Autoship Fresh & Frozen | customer profile shows fresh delivery eligible |
| Portioned fresh plan | Autoship Custom Meal Plan | customer profile shows fresh delivery eligible; pet is a dog or a cat |
| Prescription item | Autoship Pharmacy | linked prescription active with at least 1 fill remaining |
| Compounded prescription | Autoship Compounded Pharmacy | linked prescription active with at least 1 fill remaining |

## Enrollment conditions

1. **Refrigerated delivery zone.** When the program's refrigerated-zone setting is Yes, the customer's profile shows fresh delivery eligible as true.
2. **Prescription.** When the program requires a prescription, the linked prescription is in status active, with fills remaining of at least 1 and an expiry date later than the first ship date.
3. **Frequency.** The frequency lies between the program's shortest and longest frequency, in whole multiples of its frequency step.
4. **Quantity.** The quantity may not exceed the program's most units per shipment. For a pharmacy program, the quantity multiplied by the days' supply per unit may not exceed the program's largest days' supply in one shipment.
5. **First ship date.** The first ship date is the date the customer chooses, no earlier than the enrollment date and falling on one of the program's ship weekdays; a chosen date on another weekday moves to the next listed weekday.
6. **Custom Meal Plan basis weight.** An Autoship Custom Meal Plan records the pet's current recorded weight as the plan's basis weight.

Conditions 1 and 2 rest on the company's records — the customer profile and the prescription on file — checked before the enrollment is made.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical)

- **Prescription expiry.** First ship date chosen as a given day; the prescription expires on that same day: condition 2 is not met, because the expiry must be later than the first ship date. Expiring the following day: met.
- **Fills remaining.** 1 fill remaining: met. 0 fills remaining: not met.
- **Weekday move.** An Autoship Fresh & Frozen enrollment (ship weekdays Mon, Tue, Wed) with a chosen date falling on a Thursday moves to the following Monday.
- **Days' supply.** On Autoship Pharmacy (largest days' supply 90), 3 units of 30 days each give 90 days and are allowed; 2 units of 60 days each give 120 days and are not.
